# Portfolio Studio character assets

The original Builder, Creative, Explorer and Founder appearances use the local
GLB files `human-male.glb`, `human-female.glb`, `human-male-longsleeve.glb`,
`human-male-jacket.glb` and `human-female-hoodie.glb`.

Each file contains a skinned humanoid rig and embedded image textures. The
runtime uses the same GLTF loader and skeleton cloning path as the KayKit CC0
characters. Studio accessories remain procedural attachments on head, hand and
body joints, so changing the outfit or accessory does not replace the rigged
character asset.
